Task 4: Energy Savings Verification Following the data management plan, staff collected, stored, and analyzed energy use and maintenance data before and after retrofits. Data collection began in February 2024. Over 15 months, NREL gathered utility bills to compare with data from previous years, including from the original energy audits. Building use and occupancy changed over the project’s period of performance, which spanned the COVID-19 pandemic; this introduced some uncertainty into the energy savings analysis. However, the data show that compared with the building performance during and just before the energy audits, the Tribal Office saw energy reductions by about 47% EUI. 4.1 Collect data: Utility bills (electricity and #1 Heating Oil) were collected for the Office building. All data were stored in a secure location. 4.2 Analyze data: Staff analyzed the data to evaluate potential changes in building performance and energy consumption, and results were presented in graphical and written formats in Section 6 of this report. For this Technical Assistance effort, utility bills for electricity and fuel oil usage were supplied by NVA employees and the utility for the calendar years 2023 through March 2025. Actual and modeled data used in the 2017 energy audit were obtained from the energy auditor. Task 5: Outreach NVA presented annual updates at the OIE Program Review each November (2022, 2023, 2024). NREL presented on behalf of NVA in 2024; NREL also created a poster/flyer for information dissemination once the project was completed. 6 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications. 5.0 Methods NREL staff reviewed building documents (i.e., as-built plans and information from the initial and follow- up energy audits) and compiled the utility data to calculate annual energy usage metrics for the Tribal Office building. Monthly utility bills for fuel oil and electricity were collected for three distinct periods: before the retrofits, during the baseline assessment period, and after the retrofits were in place. Pre- retrofit data were derived from the original energy audit and recent utility records to establish a baseline of energy consumption before any upgrades.
